newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Alpargatas to launch $60 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Alpargatas to launch $60 mln bond.

text.p: Argentina's textile and footwear company Alpargatas SAIC said Monday it plans to issue a $60 million negotiable bond.
The issue, which was approved by the board of directors, will be the eighth tranche under the company's $150 million negotiable bond program.

Alpargatas will seek approval for the issue from Argentina's capital markets watchdog, the Comision Nacional de Valores, and hopes to list the bond on the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange. It did not say when it expects to issue the debt, but approval usually takes about two months.
